owners.label: Hark the Dust
owners.description:
Casting Intro Skill - Question the Tombs, Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, or Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang grants Earth Charm.


Earth Charm

For 15s, if Jingran is the active Resonator in the team, gain an unstackable Shield equal to 1.6% of Max HP + 700 that lasts for 5s when dealing damage. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.
While Jingran is in the Yinghuo state, if he is the active Resonator in the team, he gains an unstackable Shield equal to 0.8% of Max HP + 350 that lasts for 5s when dealing damage. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

owners.label: Trace the Vestige
owners.description:
Upon entering combat, if Jingran's Ghost Shroud is below 25 points, restore it to 25 points. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.


When nearby Resonators in the team other than Jingran gain a Shield, Jingran gains 2 points of Ghost Shroud. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.


Fixation

- Upon entering combat, Jingran gains Fixation. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.
- Casting Outro Skill - Rising Fortune and Ebbing Evil grants Fixation.
- When nearby Resonators in the team other than Jingran gain a Shield, Jingran gains 15 points of Ghost Shroud and removes Fixation.

owners.label: Rising Fortune and Ebbing Evil
owners.description: Deal Fusion DMG equal to 795% of Jingran's ATK.

owners.label: Yin and Yang in Harmony, the Ultimate Law of Being
owners.description:
The DMG Multipliers of Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang, and Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide are increased by 80%.
Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang, and Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide are now immune to interruption.

owners.label: A Solitary Lantern, Across Lands Shade-Trodden
owners.description:
The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Soul Raid and Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander are increased by 46%. While in the Yinghuo state, the DMG Multiplier increase effect via Fire of Life on Heavy Attack - Soul Raid and Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased by 46%.


Upon entering combat, Jingran gains the following effects, triggered once every 4s:
- Gains 300 point of Qi.
- Gains Netherworld's Boon.


Netherworld's Boon

Casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander restores 25% of Max Resonance Energy and grants Heavy Attack - Soul Raid and Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander 180% DMG Amplification for 4s.

owners.label: World's Course Shifts, Each to Their Rightful Paths
owners.description:
When Jingran casts Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, gain 5 points of Ghost Shroud.


When Jingran casts Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls,Yang Changes, Yin Unites is replaced by Yin-Yang Everflow for 15s.


Yin-Yang Everflow

Jingran gains additional ATK based on Max HP: For every 1000 points of Jingran's Max HP, gain 50 additional ATK, up to 2500.

owners.label: Where Reality Meets Illusion, Where Living Meet Dead
owners.description: When a Resonator in the team gains a Shield, all Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30s.

owners.label: Ends Return to Beginnings, Truth of Life Laid Bare
owners.description: When Jingran takes a fatal blow, he will not fall and will instead gain a Shield equal to 50% of Max HP for 15s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 min. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

owners.label: As Favors and Feuds Fade, New Stories Await
owners.description:
Targets take 40% more Heavy Attack DMG from Jingran.


The DMG Multiplier of Chimei Wangliang is increased by 80%.


Upon entering the Yinghuo state, Jingran gains the Parade of Thousand Souls effect for 15s. During this effect, if Jingran is the active Resonator in the team, upon dealing damage, Jingran summons Chimei Wangliang to attack the targets, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.


Chimei Wangliang can be summoned this way at an interval of 1s for up to 8 times. Parade of Thousand Souls ends and the available summon charges of Chimei Wangliang reset when either of the following conditions is met:
- Cast Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls.
- Yinghuo ends or is removed.

owners.label: Upstream Along Santu
owners.description: Jingran has fixed DEF and gains HP-based Healing Bonus and ATK.

owners.label: Yinghuo
owners.description: Yinghuo enables Chimei Wangliang and enhances several sequence effects.

owners.label: Fire of Life
owners.description: Fire of Life increases Soul Raid and Stardome Meander damage based on Max HP.

owners.label: Fortune in Disguise
owners.description: Fortune in Disguise converts Max HP into Fusion DMG Bonus.

normalAttack.name: Edge of Life and Death
normalAttack.desc:
Basic Attack - Drink Soul

While in the Yin Vessel state, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 3 restores 50 points of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4 restores 50 points of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.


Basic Attack - Devil's Bane

While in the Yang Font state, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 3 restores 50 points of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4 restores 50 points of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.


Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack in the air, dealing Fusion DMG.
While in the Yin Vessel state, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in the Yang Font state, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.


Dodge Counter - Nether Dive

While in the Yin Vessel state, press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Dodge Counter - Nether Dive restores 100 points of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4.


Dodge Counter - Light Watch

While in the Yang Font state, press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Dodge Counter - Light Watch restores 100 points of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4.


Shadow Step

While in combat and on the ground, press Dodge with directional input to cast Shadow Step, dealing fix amount of Fusion DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG. This instance of damage is not affect by any DMG Bonus effects. Successful Dodge may be triggered within a certain time into the action of this skill.
While in the Yin Vessel state, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in the Yang Font state, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

resonanceSkill.name: Malevolent Encounter
resonanceSkill.desc:
Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin

While in the Yin Vessel state, Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin is available, which deals Fusion DMG.
Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin can be cast in mid-air.


Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang

While in the Yang Font state, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang is available, which deals Fusion DMG.
Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang can be cast in mid-air.


Cleanse of Impurity

Casting Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin or Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang grants Cleanse of Impurity for 4s or until one of the following conditions is met:
- Switching to another Resonator.
- Switching to the Yin Vessel or Yang Font state.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse or Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide.


Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse

While in the Yin Vessel state with Cleanse of Impurity, press or hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, restores 100 points of Qi.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.


Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide

While in the Yang Font state with Cleanse of Impurity, press or hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide restores 100 points of Qi.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

resonanceLiberation.name: Burial of Thousand Souls
resonanceLiberation.desc:
Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG, and granting 100 points of Fire of Life.
Gain the following effects after casting this skill:
- If Jingran's current HP is above 50% of the Max HP, reduce his current HP to 50% of the Max HP.
- Gain 200 points of Qi.
- Gain 3 stacks of Wayfarer's Mark.
- Enter the Yinghuo state for 15s.


Wayfarer's Mark

Max 3 stacks.
Casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander restores 200 points of Qi and reduces 1 stacks of Wayfarer's Mark. This effect lasts for 15s.


Yinghuo

- Dealing damage with Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander summons Chimei Wangliang to attack the targets, which deals Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. This effect can be triggered once per Heavy Attack - Soul Raid and Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander.
- All Fire of Life will be removed as Yinghuo ends.

introSkill.name: Question the Tombs
introSkill.desc:
Attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG. Consume and convert all Ghost Shroud to equal stacks of Fortune in Disguise.
Casting Question the Tombs restores 100 points of Qi.
While in the Yin Vessel state, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in the Yang Font state, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.


Fortune in Disguise

Max 50 stacks. Each stack of Fortune in Disguise grants additional Fusion DMG Bonus based on Jingran's Max HP: For every 1000 points of Max HP, Jingran gains 0.05% additional Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s, up to 2.5% for each stack of Fortune in Disguise.
Switching to another Resonator ends the effect.


Ghost Shroud

- Max 50 points.
- When Jingran gains a Shield, he gains 1 points of Ghost Shroud. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

forteCircuit.name: Upstream Along Santu
forteCircuit.desc:
Qi Modulation

Jingran switches between the Yin Vessel and Yang Font states by casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander. Jingran is in the Yang Font state by default.


Heavy Attack - Soul Raid

When Jingran holds 300 points of Qi while in the Yin Vessel state, hold Normal Attack to consume 300 points of Qi to cast Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, dealing Fusion DMG.
After casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, Jingran switches to the Yang Font state.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.


Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander

When Jingran holds 300 points of Qi while in the Yang Font state, hold Normal Attack to consume 300 points of Qi to cast Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, dealing Fusion DMG.
After casting Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, Jingran switches to the Yin Vessel state.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander can be cast in mid-air.


Qi

Max 300 points.
- Casting Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 3, Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4, Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 3, or Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4 restores 50 points of Qi.
- Casting Dodge Counter - Nether Dive, Dodge Counter - Light Watch, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide, or Intro Skill - Question the Tombs restores 100 points of Qi.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls or casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander with Wayfarer's Mark restores 200 points of Qi.


Fire of Life

Max 100 points.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls grants 100 points of Fire of Life.
- All Fire of Life is cleared when Yinghuo ends.
While in Yinghuo, if Fire of Life is not at 0 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=A}, casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander consumes 25 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=B} of Fire of Life, and the DMG Multiplier of this Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased based on Jingran's Max HP: The DMG Multiplier of this Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased for every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=C} of Jingran's Max HP over 25000. Up to 25000 points of Jingran's Max HP count towards this effect.


Nether to Light

- Jingran's DEF is fixed at 0.
- Jingran gains Incoming Healing Bonus based on Max HP: For every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of Max HP, Jingran receives 6.2% Incoming Healing Bonus, up to 310%.
- Jingran gains Fusion DMG Bonus based on Max HP: For every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=E} of Max HP, Jingran receives 1.5% Fusion DMG Bonus, up to 75%.


Yang Changes, Yin Unites

Jingran gains additional ATK based on Max HP: For every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=F} of Max HP, Jingran gains 36 additional ATK, up to 1800.
